lineageLegend.confirmed: parent->child relationship stated by Taylor or in-text
lineageLegend.unsorted: named Bob whose specific parent Taylor left unassigned
lineageLegend.non-bob: recurring character often mistaken for a clone; not a replicant

seatStatusLegend.$comment: Seat assignment is no longer tracked in this file. See /bobiverse/bobs.json for who is seated and on what.
seatStatusLegend.canonOnly: This file is the Bobiverse canon genealogy (Dennis E. Taylor's tree). It answers 'who are the Bobs'. bobs.json answers 'who works for Jamey'.

meta.renderHint: tree is nested via `children`; pass tree to d3.hierarchy(). nonBobs render as a separate side group.

seatRoster.$comment: MOVED. Jamey's live crew roster is no longer duplicated here. It is served alongside this file at /bobiverse/bobs.json and mastered in the gray-matter space at */bobs.json. Casey (RR) owns it. Do not re-add a copy: the copy that used to live here went stale and contradicted the master.

tree.name: Bob-1 (Original)
tree.description: The Robert Johansson upload; woke at Epsilon Eridani and started the whole replicant line.

children.name: Bill
children.description: Stay-behind researcher. Skunk Works, androids, SCUT and SUDDAR tech.

children.name: Homer
children.description: Comic-relief clone; helped defend Sol, deliberately annoying, lost at Earth.

children.name: Garfield
children.description: Bill's lab-partner clone; helped run the Skunk Works.

children.name: Khan
children.description: Militarily-minded; led the cohort that confronted Medeiros.

children.name: Loki
children.description: Khan's backup restored as a new clone; liked playing the bad guy.

children.name: Hannibal
children.description: Part of Khan's war cohort.

children.name: Daedalus
children.description: Flew a planetoid into the Others' home sun (Book 3).

children.name: Icarus
children.description: Flew the other planetoid into the Others' sun (Book 3).

children.name: Thor
children.description: Early clone Taylor admits he missed on the first genealogy pass.

children.name: Riker
children.description: Went to Sol as Earth's guardian; later just goes by 'Will'.

children.name: Mario
children.description: Quiet introvert; deep-space explorer, found the Pav.

children.name: Milo
children.description: Struck out for Omicron-2 Eridani ('Vulcan').

children.name: Marvin
children.description: Luke/Bender cohort; befriended the Deltans alongside Archimedes.

children.name: Luke
children.description: Luke/Bender cohort explorer.

children.name: Bender
children.description: The famous LOST Bob; vanished. The quest of Heaven's River (Book 4).

children.name: Calvin
children.description: Colonized Poseidon, the all-ocean water world (Delta Eridani).

children.name: Goku
children.description: Calvin's cohort, Poseidon.

children.name: Bruce
children.description: Calvin/Goku cohort.

children.name: Howard
children.description: One of the most 'human' Bobs; settled among the colonists, loves Bridget.

children.name: Bridget
children.description: Human colonist and Howard's love. Own novel planned. Honorary seat only.

children.name: Neil
children.description: Found, repaired, and flew the Others' ship to Earth to evacuate humanity.

children.name: Herschel
children.description: Neil's partner on the Others'-ship rescue.

children.name: Unsorted Cohort

children.name: Steve
children.description: Surveyed HIP 84051 for the Pav's new home ('just a random Bob', per Taylor).

children.name: Victor
children.description: Took up the trail of Bender.

children.name: Mickey
children.description: Named in passing across the cohorts.

children.description: Named in passing across the cohorts.

children.name: Charles
children.description: Named in passing across the cohorts.

children.description: Named in passing across the cohorts.

children.name: Hal
children.description: A Bob lost in For We Are Many.

nonBobs.name: Guppy / GUPPI
nonBobs.description: Bob's fish-shaped onboard AI assistant. Not a replicant.

nonBobs.name: Archimedes
nonBobs.description: Deltan native; the stone-age aliens Bob mentors. Not a replicant.

lore.replicativeDrift: Every cohort throws one wildly divergent clone, and each generation lands further from Bob-1. Far enough out, a 'Bob' barely identifies as Bob. Same seed, diverging instances, no two running identically once separated by distance and time.
